test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Arguement'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of **'Arguement'** is** 'Argument'.**
 
• **Argument - **an angry discussion between two or more people who disagree with each other.
 
 
• **Example -** Kavya had an** argument **with her mother about politics.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is *option 1*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

Let's have a look at other given options:

 
• **Performance -** the act of performing something in front of an audience.
 
• **Valuable - **very useful, worth a lot of money.
 
• **Secretary -** an official of a club or society who is responsible for keeping records, writing letters, etc.
